scope: Alpha Magnetic Spectrometer (AMS-02) on the ISS: subsystems and observables, charged cosmic-ray fluxes and ratios, leptons, antimatter searches, isotopes, time-dependent analyses, and the public-evidence ledger (60 sources, 184 claims; last full verification 2026-09-20, some rows 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-05). Public-domain reasoning only: no AMS internal data, software or production listings. Access-controlled AMS-02 software and data knowledge is not part of this profile; it is supplied by the separate, access-restricted companion plugin ams02-research as profile experiment:ams-02-private, which depends on this one.
exclusions: AMS Collaboration internal data, notes, calibration constants, conditions databases, pass names, trigger bits, good-run rules and cuts, unless the user supplies them (then labelled user-supplied, never invented or completed from memory)
AMS Offline software usage, library maps, production catalogues and ntuple kits: not in this profile; available only to authorized members through the companion profile experiment:ams-02-private
Measured detector performance numbers not in the evidence ledger with their context
Collaboration review, blinding decisions and peer review
Other experiments' methods presented as AMS practice

capabilities.name: domain-modules
capabilities.scope: Reference modules (species, subsystems, methods, periods, sources) and working rules; text guidance, not executable checks

capabilities.name: evidence-ledger
capabilities.scope: Structural validity of the ams02 ledger, verification-strength ordering and index sync; not the truth of any claim

capabilities.name: analysis-spec-audit
capabilities.scope: Internal completeness and consistency of a JSON or strict-YAML AMS analysis specification; a clean audit is not physical validity

capabilities.name: papers-manifest-and-crdb-query
capabilities.scope: Offline subcommands only (manifest check, URL building, CSV summary); networked fetches are opt-in, need user approval and are not exercised by the tests

capabilities.name: flux-ratio-synthetic
capabilities.scope: Path A: synthetic two-period proton and helium fluxes with exposure normalization, unfolding, efficiency covariance, correlated He/p ratio and exposure-weighted period average; Asimov and seeded-toy closure (examples/ams-flux-ratio). Synthetic inputs only; says nothing about the real detector
